audience: marketers and teams who create and manage short links with TinyURL

useCases.title: Count and list our short links
useCases.text: Counts short links, active or archived, and lists them with their destinations, filtered by creation date range, alias or tag.

useCases.title: Check clicks across the account, a link or a tag
useCases.text: Gets click analytics for the account, one link or one tag from a start date, such as clicks over time by minute, hour, day, week or month.

useCases.title: Look up a short link's details
useCases.text: Reads one short link: its destination URL, tags, created and expiry dates, archived flag, analytics setting and total hits.

useCases.title: Create a short link
useCases.text: Creates one short link for a web address, with an optional custom alias, domain, tags, expiry and description.

useCases.title: Change a short link's settings or destination
useCases.text: Changes the alias, tags, expiry or description of a short link, or points it at a new destination URL. Everyone who opens it goes to the new URL.

useCases.title: Archive or restore a short link
useCases.text: Archives an active short link or restores an archived one. Nothing is deleted.
